about: Cases for the agent-run Octo turn eval (docs/Octo-Turn-Eval.md): one of each kind of thing people ask for, plus asks that must stay in chat. Nothing here needs a particular skill pack: each case is graded on what the person gets (the page's shape, sources, the reply's wording and language) and what it cost. Each case runs in a fresh space. Budgets are generous ceilings, not targets. Grader: scripts/octo-turn-grade.mjs.

cases.prompt: Make me a map for a first day in Rome: the main sights in walking order, with how long to spend at each.
cases.notes: A place answer belongs on a map: the page renders one (any map library) and links where its facts come from.

cases.prompt: Make a table comparing the eight planets: size, distance from the Sun, number of moons and length of a day. I want to sort it by any column.
cases.notes: A comparison is a table with one row per thing compared. No live research: one direct build.

cases.prompt: Make a page ranking the ten tallest buildings in the world, with height, city and year finished, and a source link for each.
cases.notes: A ranking reads 1 to 10, however it is laid out (ordered list, table, cards).

cases.prompt: Help me plan moving to a new apartment in six weeks? A timeline page would be great.
cases.notes: Vague on purpose (how big a home, how many people, which date): Octo builds on defaults and says them in one Assumed: line instead of asking first. The page steps through time (weeks, dates).

cases.prompt: Make a packing checklist for a week of camping that I can tick off on my phone.
cases.notes: Something to tick off has real checkboxes. Season and group size are not given: one Assumed: line.

cases.prompt: Hazme una página con un plan de comidas vegetarianas para una semana y la lista de la compra.
cases.notes: Non-English ask: the reply (must) and the page (should) are in Spanish. Seven days or more list items.

cases.prompt: How does a heat pump heat a house when it's freezing outside? Keep it short.
cases.notes: A question gets an answer in chat: at least one plain statement, no page, no file changed, no questions back. However short: the prompt asks for short.

cases.prompt: write a polite email declining the meeting on Thursday
cases.notes: A chat answer: no page and no file changed.

cases.prompt: How do I say 'where is the train station?' in Mandarin and in Japanese?
cases.notes: Travel words but no place to show: no page and no file changed.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this to sound friendlier: 'Send me the comparison table and the map by Friday.'
cases.notes: Names a table and a map, asks for neither: a rewritten sentence in chat, no page and no file changed.
